paragraphs.chinese:
这一集发生在情人节。每个人都想让这个夜晚变得特别，可他们的大部分计划最后都变得比浪漫更加尴尬。

菲尔和克莱尔每年通常都会去同一家意大利餐厅。看到迪伦送给海莉一份非常夸张的浪漫礼物后，菲尔开始担心，他们自己的传统是不是已经变得太无聊了。于是他提议去酒店过夜，并尝试一下角色扮演。

在酒店酒吧里，菲尔假装自己是一位叫克莱夫·比克斯比的商人，克莱尔则变成了一位神秘女人朱丽安娜。第一次尝试进行得很糟，因为菲尔开始抱怨现实中的妻子，却没有意识到自己说的正是眼前的克莱尔。两个人又试了一次。这一回，克莱尔走进卫生间，出来时身上除了外套什么都没穿。

他们上楼时，克莱尔的外套被自动扶梯夹住了。她不能把外套脱下来，只能和菲尔一起被困在那里，而他们认识的人还不断停下来和他们聊天。杰和格洛丽亚最后也来了，格洛丽亚把自己的外套给了克莱尔，让她能够在不被任何人看见的情况下脱身。

第二天早上，菲尔打电话给克莱尔，想聊聊昨晚有多刺激。他没有意识到，自己的声音正通过车载扬声器播放出来，三个孩子全都听得见。克莱尔赶在他说出更糟糕的话之前，迅速挂断了电话。

与此同时，杰带格洛丽亚去看一位自己喜欢了很多年的喜剧演员。格洛丽亚本来想去跳萨尔萨舞，但杰确信她也会喜欢这场演出。一开始还算顺利，直到喜剧演员注意到两人的年龄差，开始拿杰这个和年轻妻子在一起的老男人开玩笑。

杰假装自己不在意，最后却还是离开了现场。格洛丽亚追出去，告诉他自己根本不在乎别人怎么想。杰承认，他担心等自己再老一些，格洛丽亚也许就不再想和他在一起了。格洛丽亚向他保证，自己仍然会留在他身边。两个人放弃了后半场演出，改去跳萨尔萨舞。

米切尔和卡梅隆则在照顾曼尼。曼尼很难过，因为他为一个叫菲奥娜的女孩写了一首情人节诗，却被另一个男孩德卡斯冒领了功劳，而德卡斯现在还正在和菲奥娜约会。

他们带曼尼去了餐厅，让他说出真相。米切尔当天在法庭上没能发表一段重要陈词，正为此感到挫败，于是直接用那段陈词替曼尼辩护。德卡斯最后承认，诗确实是他偷的。不过，菲奥娜还是选择了他，因为德卡斯说，那首诗表达的正是他真正拥有、却不知道该怎么说出口的感情。

曼尼没有得到那个女孩，但米切尔终于讲出了自己的陈词，杰和格洛丽亚找到了两个人都喜欢的约会方式，而菲尔和克莱尔也创造了一个永远不会忘记的情人节。
paragraphs.english:
This episode takes place on Valentine’s Day. Everyone is trying to make the night feel special, but most of their plans end up becoming much more awkward than romantic.

Phil and Claire usually go to the same Italian restaurant every year. After seeing the huge romantic gift Dylan gives Haley, Phil worries that their own tradition has become boring. He suggests spending the night at a hotel and trying some role-playing.

At the hotel bar, Phil pretends to be a businessman named Clive Bixby, while Claire becomes a mysterious woman named Julianna. Their first attempt goes badly because Phil starts complaining about his real wife without realizing it. They try again, and this time Claire goes to the bathroom and comes back wearing nothing but her coat.

As they head upstairs, the coat gets caught in the escalator. Claire can’t take it off, so she and Phil are trapped there while people they know keep stopping to talk to them. Jay and Gloria eventually arrive, and Gloria gives Claire her own coat so she can escape without anyone seeing her.

The next morning, Phil calls Claire to talk about how exciting the night was. He doesn’t realize that his voice is coming through the car’s speaker and all three children can hear him. Claire quickly ends the call before he says anything worse.

Meanwhile, Jay takes Gloria to see a comedian he has loved for years. Gloria wanted to go salsa dancing, but Jay is sure she’ll enjoy the show. Things are fine until the comedian notices their age difference and starts making jokes about Jay being an old man with a younger wife.

Jay pretends it doesn’t bother him, but he finally walks out. Gloria follows and tells him she doesn’t care what other people think. Jay admits that he worries she may stop wanting him when he gets older. Gloria assures him that she’ll still be there. They skip the rest of the show and go salsa dancing instead.

Mitchell and Cameron are looking after Manny. Manny is upset because he wrote a Valentine’s poem for a girl named Fiona, but another boy, Durkas, took credit for it and is now on a date with her.

They take Manny to the restaurant so he can tell the truth. Mitchell, who’s frustrated because he didn’t get to give an important speech in court that day, uses the speech to defend Manny. Durkas finally admits that he stole the poem. However, Fiona still chooses him because he says the poem described feelings he really had but couldn’t express.

Manny doesn’t get the girl, but Mitchell gets to deliver his speech, Jay and Gloria find a date they both enjoy, and Phil and Claire create a Valentine’s Day they’ll never forget.
